overview_description.description:
Linx Security provides an AI-powered platform for identity security, governance, and administration. The system manages human, non-human, and agentic identities, offering automated access provisioning, onboarding, offboarding, and role-based access management. It uses graph-based modeling to map identity relationships and evaluate risk, enabling teams to detect anomalies, enforce least-privilege access, and manage entitlements across applications and systems.

The platform incorporates AI agents that support investigation, remediation, and reporting while automating routine identity workflows. It also offers just-in-time access controls and continuous monitoring to maintain security posture without interrupting operations. Linx Security integrates with multiple data sources to provide a unified view of organizational identities and access across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem environments.

Through automation and analytics, the company’s platform supports efficient identity lifecycle management, risk assessment, and governance for both human and non-human accounts.

about_short_description.short_description: Linx Security provides an AI-powered platform for identity security, governance, and administration.

product.name: Linx Identity Security Platform
product.description: An AI-native platform that provides unified visibility, governance, risk analysis, and automated control across human, non-human, and AI identities.

product.name: Linx Modern Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
product.description: A cloud-based IGA solution for managing access requests, approvals, provisioning, access reviews, remediation, and audit evidence across enterprise applications.

product.name: Linx Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM)
product.description: A continuous identity risk management solution that maps identities, entitlements, and resources to detect and remediate dormant accounts, privilege sprawl, missing MFA, and other access weaknesses.

product.name: Linx AI Access Control
product.description: A real-time access control solution for AI agents that evaluates and enforces tool-level policies before agent actions execute, while recording attributable audit trails.

product.name: Linx Identity Lifecycle Management
product.description: An identity lifecycle solution that automates joiner, mover, and leaver workflows, access provisioning and removal, and role- or attribute-based least-privilege enforcement.

product.name: Linx Agentic Identity Governance
product.description: A governance solution for discovering, mapping, and controlling AI agents and other non-human identities, including their owners, credentials, access paths, and activity.
